strategy_change: Roadtrip supply no longer depends on one discovery system.
Source A remains Overpass for rich place discovery.
If Source A still cannot make the selected itinerary feasible, Source B independently reverse-geocodes geographically spread regional seed points through Nominatim into real named settlements.
Source B has no dependency on the Overpass discovery lock, so lock contention, endpoint failure or sparse Overpass results cannot by themselves collapse the selected trip.
The solver and hard roadtrip rules remain unchanged after the candidate sources are merged.
ui_change: Removed the top '+ Nieuwe reis' button. The dashboard 'Start een nieuwe reis' is the single new-trip action.
